_comment: OCG layer rules from a real ArchiCAD export (Georgian layer names, English roles). plan-pdf-layers.py keeps only these layers, in this order (bottom to top). take: all | fills | strokes. fill_colors: keep only fills of these colors. also_stroke_colors: with take=fills, also keep stroke-only objects of these colors. exclude_stroke_colors: drop objects stroked with these colors (hatching). drop_strokes: in ink mode, stroke chains become a black fill when they close from axis-parallel segments, black lines when open, and are dropped when diagonal (hatch, column crosses) or shorter than tick_px. white_fill_to_ink: white fills become black (columns).

keep.role: bearing walls; orange strokes are door arcs and leaves
black window wedges only; orange here is evacuation arrows
composite panels between mullions and walls

units._comment: Layer where the architect outlined measured apartment and balcony areas with single line segments.
